user_priority: Fewer search decisions or complete candidate evaluations to the same exact result; factor operations, verification, learning/preprocessing and memory costs counted separately. Speed alone is not acceptance.
defaults: New strategies opt in; current default solver behavior retained.

entries.title: Ranked route/key fixed-point propagation
entries.acceptance: Same exhaustive distinct-text top-k, canonical recipes and ties; fewer branch decisions on coupled-clue controls, with propagation work included.

entries.title: Early partial ragged-segmentation rejection
entries.acceptance: Reject only partial length patterns that have no feasible completion; independent enumeration confirms coverage and fewer completed segmentations on discriminating controls.

entries.title: Constrained interleaved variable choice
entries.acceptance: Choose route or key unknowns by remaining constraint impact; exact completed outcomes and checkpoint continuation preserved, unique route/assignment counts truthful.

entries.title: Shared-key correlated joint bounds
entries.acceptance: Every bound dominates the exhaustive residual maximum; same exact top-k with fewer completed key candidates on declared controls; strict ties and capped fallback.

entries.title: Proven equivalent-route suppression
entries.acceptance: Deduplicate only proven invariant route choices before scoring; exact distinct-text ranking and canonical labelled representative retained; evaluation counts separate from multiplicities.

entries.title: Shared unfinished equivalent-family scans
entries.acceptance: Compatible certified scans continue one owned committed coordinate sequence; different recipe aliases independently replay; no duplicate committed candidate work, false complete ranking or cross-model/mask reuse.

entries.title: Reusable exact residual subproblems
entries.acceptance: Bounded component contexts reuse exact optima and witnesses within an immutable objective; original-factor verification and lexical ties preserved; zero score is never a proof of infeasibility.

entries.title: Cheap certified rejection before stronger bounds
entries.acceptance: An inexpensive valid bound may reject before group/mini-bucket calculations; preserve full bounds for retained checkpoints; count factor operations and extra checks separately.

protocol_policy: Freeze authored controls and finite oracle domains before comparing outcomes. Preserve unfavorable cases, cutoff evidence and failed variants. No re-scoring the reserved O language benchmark for tuning. Canonical manifests and immutable source snapshots after implementation freeze.
non_claims: No deletion of earlier evidence or return of removed contributor history
